pregunta: ¿Qué agente tuvo más facturas vigentes en 2005?
sql_modelo:
WITH facturas_por_agente AS (
  SELECT TRIM(ref1) AS agente, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM faccab
  WHERE UPPER(TRIM(status)) = 'V'
    AND LEFT(TRIM(fecha), 4) = '2005'
    AND TRIM(ref1) <> ''
  GROUP BY TRIM(ref1)
),
clasificado AS (
  SELECT agente, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY n DESC) AS rk
  FROM facturas_por_agente
)
SELECT agente
FROM clasificado
WHERE rk = 1
ORDER BY agente

pregunta: ¿Cuántas facturas vigentes no tienen una fecha válida?
sql_modelo:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT btrim(fecha) AS f, btrim(status) AS st FROM faccab
),
parsed AS (
  SELECT
    f,
    st,
    CASE WHEN f ~ '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])$'
         THEN substring(f, 1, 4)::int END AS y,
    CASE WHEN f ~ '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])$'
         THEN substring(f, 5, 2)::int END AS m,
    CASE WHEN f ~ '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])$'
         THEN substring(f, 7, 2)::int END AS d
  FROM base
),
checked AS (
  SELECT
    st,
    CASE
      WHEN y IS NOT NULL AND y > 0 AND d <= (
        CASE m
          WHEN 1 THEN 31
          WHEN 2 THEN CASE WHEN (y % 4 = 0 AND y % 100 <> 0) OR y % 400 = 0 THEN 29 ELSE 28 END
          WHEN 3 THEN 31
          WHEN 4 THEN 30
          WHEN 5 THEN 31
          WHEN 6 THEN 30
          WHEN 7 THEN 31
          WHEN 8 THEN 31
          WHEN 9 THEN 30
          WHEN 10 THEN 31
          WHEN 11 THEN 30
          WHEN 12 THEN 31
        END)
      THEN true ELSE false
    END AS fecha_valida
  FROM parsed
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS facturas_vigentes_fecha_invalida
FROM checked
WHERE st = 'V' AND NOT fecha_valida

pregunta: ¿Qué productos y cantidades incluye la factura 0000001647 de la serie A?
sql_modelo:
SELECT p.descripcion AS producto, f.cantidad AS cantidad
FROM facdet f
JOIN productos p ON btrim(p.clave) = btrim(f.producto)
WHERE replace(btrim(f.serie), ' ', '') = 'A'
  AND replace(btrim(f.numfac), ' ', '') = '0000001647'
  AND f.status = 'A'
ORDER BY f.renglon
sql_referencia:
WITH vigentes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (serie, LPAD(TRIM(numfac), 10, '0'))
         serie, LPAD(TRIM(numfac), 10, '0') AS folio, cliente, rfc, fecha, total, ref1, status
  FROM faccab
  ORDER BY serie, LPAD(TRIM(numfac), 10, '0'), fcaptura DESC
) SELECT d.renglon, d.producto, d.cantidad, REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(d.importe), '$', ''), ',', '')::numeric AS importe FROM facdet d JOIN vigentes f ON d.serie = f.serie AND LPAD(TRIM(d.numfac), 10, '0') = f.folio WHERE f.status = 'V' AND d.status = 'A' AND f.serie = 'A' AND f.folio = '0000001647' ORDER BY d.renglon
